tone.neg: Explicit adverse news for US equities/chips: earnings miss/cut, restrictive rates, tariffs/export bans, downgrade, recession warning, panic selling; example: Chips slide on export curbs.
tone.pos: Explicit beneficial news: earnings beat/raise, easing/truce, upgrade, actual buying, rebound on relief; example: Stocks rally as tariff pause eases fears.
tone.neutral: Mixed positives/negatives without dominant broad-equity/chip implication, unchanged data, event previews, or no explicit directional implication. A price decline alone in a factual close story is neg but marked technical if no catalyst is reported.

coding.priority: Use main headline/lead causal material rather than narrative subordinate details; conflicting main implications -> neutral; type chooses dominant causal content. Do not infer tone from future returns.
coding.turn_catalyst: Y only for contemporaneous reports on anchor or +1 session explicitly connecting a reversal to a reported event. Mere same-day occurrence insufficient. Otherwise N. Categories policy / earnings / flows / strategist / none derived from type; no proof of causation.
coding.comparison: Counts neg/total and type counts by real/fake and bin; no conversion of 10 episodes to bottom prediction probability.

date_note: RSS UTC timestamp converted to America/New_York for candidate date, flagged feed-only; source publication day supersedes if verified; non-session maps next XNYS session; current future dates >11/10 unobservable
wire_requirement: Reuters/AP close per window session; missing explicitly reported, never treated as no adverse news
